description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeFirewallPolicy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeFirewallPolicy spec.

description.description: An optional description of this resource. Provide this property when you create the resource.

folderRef.description: Immutable. The Folder that this resource belongs to. Only one of [folderRef, organizationRef] may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The 'name' field of a folder, when not managed by Config Connector. The recommended format is "folders/{folderID}".

organizationRef.description: Immutable. The Organization that this resource belongs to. Only one of [folderRef, organizationRef] may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The 'name' field of an organization, when not managed by Config Connector.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The service-generated name of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.

shortName.description: Immutable. User-provided name of the Organization firewall policy. The name should be unique in the organization in which the firewall policy is created. The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with RFC1035. Specifically, the name must be 1-63 characters long and match the regular expression [a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])? which means the first character must be a lowercase letter, and all following characters must be a dash, lowercase letter, or digit, except the last character, which cannot be a dash.
